result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers correctly identify the pre-ticked, one-click send as the main risk. Both also give strong, ordered fixes for the send step, owner guessing, provenance and the confidence pill. A ties the 1-in-5 figure more directly to the need for per-item source checks and has an explicit 'What to keep' section. B never says what to keep. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers find the same main risk and offer similar fixes: gate the send, add sources, make owners easy to edit and fix the pill. B ties the 1-in-5 owner error rate directly to adding a source for each item and backs it with the 74% chance that at least one of six owners is wrong. B also names what to keep. A never says what to keep, and it puts sources third without tying them clearly to the owner errors.
